🛠️ Trailermekanikere søges til førende dansk vognmandsforretning i København

Har du skruet hænderne rigtigt på, og vil du være en del af et stærkt hold hos en af Danmarks største vognmænd?

Vi har rasende travlt og søger lige nu 2-3 dygtige trailermekanikere til vores moderne værksted i København. Uanset om du er i job i dag og trænger til luftforandring, eller om du er klar til at starte med det samme, hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en af landets førende vognmandsforretninger med en solid flåde på ca. 750 lastbiler og 1700 trailere. På værkstedet er tempoet højt, humøret godt, og du vil indgå i et stærkt team af dedikerede kollegaer, der løfter i flok for at holde vognparken kørende og trafiksikker.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver:

• 
Fejlfinding og reparation af jeres store trailerflåde.

• 
Planlagt vedligeholdelse og serviceeftersyn.

• 
Klargøring til syn og sikring af, at alt sikkerhedsudstyr er i top.

• 
Tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer på værkstedet for at sikre et hurtigt og effektivt workflow.

Hvem er du?

• 
Erfaren: Du har konkret erfaring med reparation og vedligeholdelse af lastbiltrailere.

• 
Sprog: Du taler minimum engelsk (polsk er også en stor fordel, men ikke et krav).

• 
Mentalitet: Du er fleksibel, mødestabil og ikke bange for at tage fat, når der er travlt.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

• 
Stærkt fællesskab: Masser af gode, dygtige og dedikerede kollegaer, der glæder sig til at tage imod dig.

• 
Ordnede forhold: Trygge rammer i en stor, stabil og professionelt drevet virksomhed.

• 
Attraktiv løn: God lønpakke, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

• 
Hurtig opstart: Vi har brug for dig nu, så du kan starte med det samme.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi holder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at række ud!

Hvis du vil høre mere om dette spændende job, kan du kontakte [Indsæt Navn] på telefon: [Indsæt Nummer] eller sende dit CV direkte til: [Indsæt E-mail].

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Kontakt:
Søren Storm - 2620 82 45 - ss@powerpeople.dk

🛠️ Trailer mechanics wanted for a leading Danish haulage company in Copenhagen

Are you handy with tools, and do you want to be part of a strong team at one of Denmark’s largest haulage companies?

We are extremely busy and are currently looking for 2–3 skilled trailer mechanics for our modern workshop in Copenhagen. Whether you are currently employed and looking for a change of scenery, or ready to start immediately, we would love to hear from you!

Who are we?

We are one of the country’s leading haulage companies, operating a substantial fleet of approximately 750 trucks and 1,700 trailers. The pace in the workshop is fast and morale is high; you will join a strong team of dedicated colleagues who work together to keep the fleet running and roadworthy.

Your primary tasks:

•Troubleshooting and repairing our large trailer fleet.

•Scheduled maintenance and service inspections.

•Preparing trailers for inspections and ensuring all safety equipment is in top condition.

•Working closely with workshop colleagues to ensure a fast and efficient workflow.

Who are you?

•Experienced: You have hands-on experience repairing and maintaining truck trailers.

•Language: You speak at least English (Polish is a major advantage but not a requirement).

•Mindset: You are flexible, reliable, and not afraid to roll up your sleeves when things get busy.

What do we offer? 
•Strong sense of community: Plenty of great, skilled, and dedicated colleagues looking forward to welcoming you.

•Solid working conditions: A secure environment within a large, stable, and professionally run company.

•Attractive salary: A competitive compensation package that matches your qualifications.

•Immediate start: We need you now, so you can start right away.

Does this sound like the right fit for you?

We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out!

If you would like to know more about this exciting position, please contact [Insert Name] by phone at [Insert Number] or send your CV directly to [Insert Email].

We look forward to hearing from you!

Operations & Maintenance Sales & Service Manager

Job Description

Are you ready to make a difference on a global scale? If you have a commercial background in the field of Operation & Maintenance from a relevant technical industry or a technical background in intralogistics, material handling or baggage handling solutions and a passion for working internationally, this is your chance to step into a high-impact role.

As a member of the Operations & Maintenance Partner Programs Centre of Competence, you will become a trusted expert and valued specialist in our global organisation. Expect international travel as required to support business operations, customer projects, and development activities. Depending on business needs, travel may amount to up to 60 days per year, collaborating with colleagues worldwide to develop new business opportunities, support contract extensions, and help local teams deliver best-in-class services to our airport and logistics customers. This position combines technical expertise, commercial insight, and operational support in a dynamic international environment.

Facilitate great global service

At BEUMER Group, we deliver intralogistics solutions such as mission critical baggage handling systems for airports and parcel handling systems for a variety of logistic customers all over the world. We have the leading product on the market, and the office in Aarhus is an international Centre of Competence. From here, you support 29 Beumer Group Companies around the world and help carry the strategic responsibility for our global service contracts.

Support colleagues and customers globally

Working with our colleagues in 29 Group Companies around the world, you will support Operation & Maintenance solutions for their regions by driving quotations and price calculations and defining the right winning strategy. You will also support a pool of over 100 existing O&M contracts worldwide. Although most of your interactions will be internal, at times you will also be working closely with our customers, via online or physical meetings and presentations. The role, however, is quite broad and dynamic, with the main responsibilities listed below:

• Analysing customer requirements in tender documents from a commercial, operational and organizational perspective to establish the right O&M service solutions

• Identifying, analysing and mitigating risks of new opportunities and existing contracts

• Close cooperation with project teams, sales teams and all departments within the organization

• Monitoring existing contracts so as to verify that they are performing well and adhering to the global O&M processes and company strategy

• Acting as single point of contact for all O&M contracts and Group Companies as well as facilitating work in all O&M contracts while promoting know-how sharing and best practice across O&M sites globally

• Overall planning on the implementation of new service contracts, including the resources, time and commercial aspects as well as the coordination with the customer and Group Companies

• As custodians of our global O&M processes and tools, constantly reviewing and enforcing them

• Following up on the implementation and the continuous optimisation of the service concepts

People person with experience managing and quoting maintenance solutions

Responsibility, communication and collaboration. These are three skills that are essential in this outgoing role, where you act across sites and cultures. You need to be able to talk to everyone – from service technicians to CEOs – communicating convincingly and persuasively. With no direct reports, your internal networking is highly important in this role as there is constant interaction with internal departments. At the end of the day, we are looking for your clout, energy and motivation to participate in global teamwork and collaborations. The requirements for the role are:

• A commercial background in a relevant technical field or a technical background from a similar industry. Experience with managing and quoting maintenance solutions is a strong advantage but not a must.

• A great communicator, fluent in English -spoken and in written-, who can talk and challenge people at all levels of the organisation

• Excellent skills in MS Office, especially Excel.

We offer you the opportunity to become part of a family-owned global industry leader, where quality in everything we do is essential for us. We are extremely customer-driven and team-oriented, and we are only successful, when everybody participates and help each other out. Our O&M-contracts are crucial for not just our business, but also for the many airports and logistics sites we support all over the world and by joining us a our new Operations & Maintenance Sales & Service Manager, you will not just help our company and customers, but also help making sure that parcels and baggage arrive quickly and in the right hands every time.

Interested?

If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Talent Acquisition Lead, Søren Elkjær Holm, on : +45 3176 0448.

We look forward to meeting you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletising, packing, sortation and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all of our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

Driving commercial growth across global markets

**As our new Tanker Broker, you will play an important role in developing and strengthening Uni-Tankers’ commercial position within the chemical and product tanker markets. Drawing on your market knowledge, industry network, and commercial mindset, you will identify new opportunities, build close relationships, and contribute to the effective operation of our fleet.

You will be based at our headquarters in Middelfart and work closely with colleagues across Chartering, Operations, and other business functions. Travel to customers, business partners, and industry events will be a natural part of the role.

In addition, your responsibilities will be:

• Develop and maintain relationships with customers, brokers, and business partners

• Identify and secure profitable cargoes and vessel opportunities

• Optimize schedules and trading patterns

• Negotiate charter parties and commercial terms

• Monitor market developments and identify new business opportunities

• Expand Uni-Tankers’ commercial network and customer portfolio

**Your Profile

**We are looking for a commercially driven shipping professional who thrives in an international environment and enjoys creating value through strong relationships and market insight. You are curious and motivated by identifying opportunities and turning them into results, and you naturally build working relationships with colleagues, customers, and business partners alike.

We imagine that you bring 5-10 years of chartering experience within the chemical or product tanker market and have built a well-established network within the international shipping industry. You combine commercial instinct with a structured approach and are comfortable navigating complex negotiations and market dynamics.

Additionally, you:

• Possess an established network within the international shipping industry

• Demonstrate business acumen and negotiation skills

• Communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. Danish language skills are preferred

• Have solid IT skills

**What We Offer

**Uni-Tankers is committed to empowering employees and promoting their professional growth. As our new Tanker Broker, you will enjoy:

• A key commercial role with significant impact on business development and performance

• Close collaboration with experienced colleagues across the organization

• An international working environment with broad industry exposure

We are a family-owned company with a solid culture, and we support and help each other. Our core values are Decency, Leadership & Business Acumen.

**Uni-Tankers

**Uni-Tankers is a leading tanker shipping company in the intermediate and small tanker segment. The fleet is one of the youngest in its core markets, comprising approximately 45 owned and chartered modern and flexible product and chemical tankers.

Uni-Tankers was founded in 1995 as a subsidiary of the Danish, family-owned United Shipping & Trading Company (USTC). The shipowning company has offices in Denmark, Turkey, France, Singapore, and the US.

jobs.occupation: Personal Assistant to Our Partner Group
jobs.description:
Are you a skilled planner with an eye for both the big picture and the finer details, and are you passionate about an exciting everyday life in an international IT company? Then you could be our new Personal Assistant to our Partner Group at our Copenhagen office.

Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be to act as the central point of contact, orchestrating the day-to-day activities of the Partner Group through effective calendar management, document management and archiving, travel planning and booking, as well as thorough meeting preparation. Your role is to ensure that the partners can operate professionally, in a coordinated and efficient manner, while working behind the scenes to involve the right stakeholders and ensure progress.

Your proactive approach will enable the partners to focus on strategic decisions while you handle the practical and administrative aspects. Therefore, the ability to anticipate needs, identify challenges, and initiate solutions is essential.

Your responsibilities will typically include:

• Efficient management of the Partner Group’s calendars, including prioritising and optimising their time, as well as coordinating and booking travel arrangements.

• Thorough preparation of meeting materials, gathering relevant information, taking accurate meeting minutes, and following up on action items to ensure progress.

• Flexible handling of ad hoc tasks to support the Partner Group’s day-to-day activities and strategic objectives.

About you

To succeed in this role, you thrive in a dynamic environment with many different stakeholders and points of contact. At Netcompany, we set the bar high, and we are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented individual. You should be self-motivated and enjoy both proactive planning and effective problem-solving. In addition, you understand the importance of handling confidential information with loyalty and discretion. A strong understanding of the business and excellent communication skills is also essential.

We imagine that you:

• Have several years of experience as a Personal Assistant or in a similar coordinating role.

• Thrive on handling administrative and practical tasks at a high level.

• Work in a structured manner and have an exceptional ability to create and maintain an overview.

• Have strong technical skills, particularly in Microsoft Office, Outlook, and PowerPoint.

• Full professional proficiency in Danish and English (written and spoken) is a must.

We expect a high level of commitment and a dedicated and proactive approach to your responsibilities. Your ability to take initiative and contribute new ideas and solutions will be highly valued. At Netcompany, we place great emphasis on both your professional and personal development, and you will naturally receive support and guidance from your colleagues in the PA team.

Join an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we highly prioritise an inclusive community. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture based on collaboration and mutual trust, where there is always an opportunity for sparring.

As part of our culture and values, all employees, regardless of background, identity, and experience, are met with understanding and respect and given equal opportunities for development and well-being.

As we are an international company with offices in many countries, you will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate internationally with colleagues from across the world. We offer a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we have a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network early in your career.

Send us your application

Upload your resume and a motivational letter to our recruitment system via the link. If you have unanswered questions, feel free to write to hr.dk@netcompany.com.

All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of gender, gender expression, sexuality, disability, age, religion and belief, political views, nationality, ethnicity, or social background.

We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse environment. Our recruitment processes are based on individual merit. If you require any reasonable adjustments or additional support during the interview process, please email our recruiters at reasonableadjustments@netcompany.com for assistance. #LI-SA1

Robotics Software Engineer, Innovation & Development

• Full-time

Job Description

Join BEUMER Group Innovation & Development in creating solutions that power the next level of logistic sortation systems worldwide. As a Robotics Software Engineer at BEUMER Group, you’ll design innovative solutions that drive efficiency and reliability in sortation and handling systems for logistic sites around the globe.

Our logistics customers seek innovative solutions to improve the efficiency of their sites. This includes automating manual processes through technologies such as mobile carrier robots, articulated robots, and computer vision software. More broadly, digitalization is a key driver of efficiency improvements.

To meet these needs, we are intensifying our focus on innovation and investing more in bringing new products to the market to address our customers’ evolving needs, making this an exciting time to join BEUMER Group.

Global innovation team

As our new Robotics Software Engineer, you will join a local, cross-functional Innovation & Development team consisting of highly skilled professionals in computer vision, robotics, user experience design, software architecture, and software development. The team operates in a global setup and collaborates closely with colleagues across locations and disciplines. The team's mission is to develop innovative products and systems for the logistics industry.

In your role as Robotics Software Engineer, you will:

• Develop, maintain, and debug software on industrial PCs and robotic platforms, including communication and computer vision applications.

• Configure, program, and integrate industrial robots and motion control systems.

• Work with geometric and spatial calculations related to robot motion, object positioning, and vision-guided applications.

• Participate in the development of new products, from early prototypes to market-ready solutions.

• Collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across disciplines and locations in a global organization.

Driving business value

You have a strong background in designing and implementing automation solutions across a range of software platforms. You are innovative, proactive, and capable of developing automation systems and software that enhance efficiency and create business value.

You bring the following qualifications to the role:

• A degree in computer science, engineering, physics, or a related field.

• Experience with robotics and automation technologies, preferably from a similar or related industry.

• Experience developing near real-time software and solid knowledge of C#. Experience with Python, Docker, and microservice architecture is an advantage.

• Interest in robotics software and technologies, particularly in combination with computer vision applications.

• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in a dynamic environment.

• Strong understanding of geometry and spatial reasoning, including the ability to model and calculate physical dimensions, positions, and movements in real-world systems.

Want to know more?

See our video from PostNord Logistics: Logistic system - BEUMER Group.

Interested?

If you have any questions regarding this position, please do not hesitate to contact Team Manager of Logistic System Product Development Ejnar Nielsen on +45 2721 4733 or Talent Acquisition Lead Søren Elkjær Holm on +45 3176 0448.

Job description

Are you an experienced HR professional who enjoys combining HR operations, employee support and employment compliance in an international environment?

We are looking for a structured, service-minded and proactive HR Generalist to join our Global People Support team. You will take a key role in supporting employees hired from Denmark and become a central point of contact for matters related to Danish employment administration, employee cases and HR processes.

You will work closely with employees, managers, HR colleagues and external stakeholders to ensure that HR processes are handled professionally, efficiently and in line with Danish employment legislation, collective agreements and internal requirements.

As part of our Global People Support team, you will contribute to delivering a high-quality and consistent HR service across the organization. At the same time, you will take particular ownership of Danish employment administration and help strengthen our knowledge, processes and ways of working within this area.

Your Responsibilities

As HR Generalist, you will manage and coordinate a broad range of HR activities across the employee lifecycle, including:

• 
Managing employee cases related to Danish employment legislation and applicable collective agreements

• 
Coordinating sickness absence administration and follow-up

• 
Handling pension-related employee administration

• 
Coordinating work injury and accident reporting

• 
Providing guidance to employees and managers on Danish employment administration and HR processes

• 
Managing correspondence with relevant authorities and supporting statutory reporting requirements

• 
Maintaining accurate employee master data and HR settings in D365 HR and related systems

• 
Preparing and issuing employment-related documentation, including employment contracts and social security documentation

• 
Supporting continuous improvement and standardization of HR administrative processes

• 
Collaborating closely with colleagues across HR to ensure a consistent and professional employee experience

Job requirements

What We Are Looking For

We imagine that you have solid experience from an HR operational environment and enjoy taking ownership while working collaboratively with others.

Ideally, you:

• 
Have experience from an HR Generalist, HR Administrator, HR Coordinator or HR Operations role

• 
Have good working knowledge of Danish employment law, collective agreements and HR administration

• 
Have experience handling employee cases and correspondence with Danish authorities

• 
Are comfortable working with HR systems and maintaining accurate employee data

• 
Work in a structured and detail-oriented way and are comfortable managing several cases and priorities simultaneously

• 
Have a service-minded approach and enjoy supporting both employees and managers

• 
Communicate confidently and professionally in Danish and English, both verbally and in writing

• 
Are collaborative, approachable and comfortable working in an international HR environment

• 
Take ownership of your responsibilities and naturally look for opportunities to improve processes and ways of working

What We Offer

At Global Wind Service, you will join an international organisation operating in the renewable energy sector and become part of a global HR community where collaboration, responsibility and continuous improvement are an important part of how we work.

We offer:

• 
An opportunity to join an international company within the wind industry

• 
A role with real ownership and the opportunity to develop your expertise within Danish HR operations

• 
Close collaboration with colleagues across our global HR organisation

• 
Opportunities for professional and personal development

• 
A competitive compensation package including pension, insurance, laptop and mobile phone

• 
A hybrid working model offering flexibility

• 
Global career development opportunities

• 
A dynamic, inclusive and informal working environment

• 
A workplace where employee well-being and collaboration matter

Joining Global Wind Service means becoming part of a global organization where you can develop your HR expertise while contributing to an industry focused on a more sustainable future.

About Global Wind Service

Global Wind Service was established in Denmark in 2008 with a clear ambition to be a preferred project partner for the installation, service and maintenance of wind turbines worldwide.

Today, Global Wind Service employs approximately 2,000 dedicated professionals and operates internationally with offices across Europe, the United States and Asia.

Global Wind Service is a Fred. Olsen related company with a long-term strategy and ownership.

Our Aspiration and Values

Our aspiration is to be a global tier-one project partner for wind turbine installation, service and blade repair, both offshore and onshore.

At Global Wind Service, our values are:

Be Safe. Act Flexible. Take Responsibility. Focus on People.

These values guide the way we work together, make decisions and support our employees. We therefore hope you can see yourself reflected in them and bring them into your everyday approach to HR.

Implementation Consultant with expertise in social services – Columna Cura

Do you know municipal case management in social services inside out – VUM, FFB, service catalogues, rates and citizens' co-payments – and would you like to help municipalities get the most out of their IT support for social services? At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. Are you an experienced commercial professional looking for an environment where your ideas matter, decisions move quickly, and your direct contribution makes a visible impact?

We built Trustpilot to be that place.

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

We’re expanding our Enterprise business across the French market, and we’re looking for collaborative, forward-thinking professionals to help shape what’s next. You’ll work with some of the region’s leading brands at a moment when AI is fundamentally changing how reputation is built and how consumers make decisions, while helping businesses use authentic human sentiment to strengthen their visibility, credibility, and competitive position in the AI economy.

If you’re energised by building new approaches, solving complex challenges, and seeing the tangible impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

This role requires native-level French and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Copenhagen office.

What you’ll be doing:

• Drive Portfolio Value: Manage a portfolio of Enterprise accounts across the French market, owning customer retention, guiding successful renewals, and identifying growth opportunities through thoughtful account mapping.

• Partner for Success: Work in close partnership with dedicated Customer Success Managers (CSMs). While you lead on commercial strategy, contract growth, and negotiations, your CSM partner guides adoption, implementation, and ongoing account health, delivering a seamless, high-value experience for our clients.

• Help Build the Playbook: Bring fresh perspectives to a growing function by sharing market insights, piloting retention and expansion initiatives, and co-creating our France Enterprise strategy.

• Demonstrate Value: Deeply understand client business goals and metrics to deliver measurable ROI, establishing Trustpilot as a trusted, long-term partner.

Who you are:

• Native-level French and strong professional English language skills

• Demonstrated track record managing Enterprise-level customer portfolios, with experience driving renewals, account retention, and commercial expansion within a SaaS or subscription-based environment.

• Comfortable navigating evolving environments, taking ownership of your outcomes, and eager to help shape an Enterprise approach rather than simply following a rigid process.

• Proven ability to co-manage complex customer relationships alongside Customer Success Managers, technical leads, and cross-functional teams.

• Skilled at leading thoughtful, consultative conversations with senior leadership and key stakeholders across diverse organizations.

• Excited to move beyond standard sales approaches and help tailor solutions that truly resonate within the European market.

What’s in it for you:

• Real ownership: influence how we grow within your market

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday with an additional 5 days after 12 months of continuous employment

• 2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Paid parental leave

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• An international workspace at our HQ in Copenhagen that’s complete with a coffee bar and canteen, with a wide variety of refreshments available. You can opt in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price.

About us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in  Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.
